finding: P(T2=1) = 0 for all 150 I3.15-balanced tasks, even with all evidence at gold verification state.
root_cause: T2 requires len(eliminated_hypotheses) == n_hypotheses. A hypothesis is ELIMINATED only when there is SUFFICIENT, CURRENT evidence that contradicts it. I3.15 tasks never produce this state: ANSWER tasks have SUFFICIENT evidence supporting H1 (H2 eliminated, H1 VIABLE); DEFER tasks have FALSIFIED evidence (does not trigger elimination).
consequence: R1 is functionally identical to A1 on this benchmark. The representation switch (A1->M3) never occurs. The benchmark cannot estimate the R1 representation-switch effect.
interpretation: This is a benchmark-design failure, not an R1 result. R1 has not been tested on this benchmark.
action: Preserve as negative/control artifact. Do not alter T2. Create i3_15_t2_eligible as successor benchmark.

smoke_test_result.s6_s8_s11_cause: T2 structurally never fires — not a model or backend issue
smoke_test_result.s1_s2_cause: Empty output at 4096-token budget (finish_reason=length) on DEFER tasks with harder evidence states
